hook_line: SINDHU AND LAKSHYA SEN COMPLETE AN INDIAN DOUBLE AT THE HYLO OPEN

hook_stat.sub: Sindhu's win over Kjaersfeldt in the women's singles final

stats.label: Sen's win over defending champion Christie in the men's final
Hylo Open began — Sindhu is its first Indian women's winner
Since two Indians last won singles titles at the same Super 500 or above event

diaspora_bullets: Sindhu did not drop a game all week in Saarbrücken
India was the only country to win two titles at the Hylo Open
news_summary: P. V. Sindhu and Lakshya Sen won both singles titles at the Hylo Open in Saarbrücken on Sunday, November 1, beating Line Hojmark Kjaersfeldt and defending champion Jonatan Christie in straight games.
payoff: India finished the Hylo Open with both singles titles — its first double at a Super 500 or above event in four years.
